title: Нужен анатомический аватар по ГОСТ  88-67-96 рост 170см
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/dfcb0ab7442647b8a427f71ce9afe0b9/images/9b6da3cb5abf488c8fede18ecae62b8cScreenshot_2026_08_27-4.jpeg)**Looking for an anatomically accurate female avatar for CLO 3D**

Hello everyone!

I am looking for a **realistic, anatomically accurate female 3D avatar** for garment construction and fitting in **CLO 3D**.

The required body measurements are:

  * **Height:** 170 cm

  * **Bust circumference:** 92 cm

  * **Waist circumference:** 70.5 cm

  * **Hip circumference:** 100 cm




The most important requirement is the **anatomical shape of the back**. I need a natural, realistic back with a normal scapular area. **The back should NOT be excessively hollow/concave in the area of the shoulder blades (scapulae)** or have an unnatural posture.

I am looking for a body that resembles a **real woman's anatomy** , rather than an idealized fashion/model body.

The avatar can be:

  * created in **Blender, ZBrush, Maya, 3ds Max, or another 3D software** ;

  * based on a real person or a high-quality 3D scan;

  * and then **adapted/converted for use in CLO 3D**.




It is important that the avatar can be imported and used properly in **CLO 3D** , with accurate body proportions and measurements.

If you create or sell custom CLO 3D avatars, or know someone who can make one according to these specifications, please contact me.

I would also appreciate examples of your previous work and information about the **price, file format, and delivery time**.

Thank you!
content_description: A community request page seeking a realistic, anatomically accurate female 3D avatar with specific body measurements and natural back anatomy for use in CLO 3D garment fitting.

title: Binding Topstitching Issues
content:
Hi, I am having issue with the topstitching on some binding looking poor. Any tips on how to improve this? 

![13d7ab42343a4d81a21dde83acc8c53b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/165624f426374592b9c0234569c492ec/images/13d7ab42343a4d81a21dde83acc8c53bBind%20stitching%20issue.JPG)I have binding on "both" sides and wanted to have some stitching visible on the under side - is this what segment B is supposed to show? Appreciate any assistance on this. Thanks!![50c0530f647b475789a4b86250e5cec2](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/165624f426374592b9c0234569c492ec/images/50c0530f647b475789a4b86250e5cec2Bind%20settings.JPG)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hmm I'm not sure for the picture alone. I'd say to try changing the fabric, the particle distance and the grain direction.

Comment 2: Hi there,To improve the visual quality of the topstitch, you can change its Type to Texture in the Property Editor (as shown in the screenshot).Because you selected "Both Sides," the binding applies to both the top and underside, placing topstitches on both sides as well. Note that Segment A and Segment B refer to the top and bottom sections of the binding, not the front and back.Complex topstitches (like an overlock) applied to both sides can strain the visual rendering. I recommend starting with a single, default topstitch first and then customizing it from there.
Reply 1: Thanks, I have opted to just apply to "Over" side for now. It looks better but it is being pulled a bit and distorted the seams. Do you have any advice on how to improve this so it looks more consistent?
content_description: This page provides tips and guidance to improve the quality of topstitching on double-sided binding with visible stitching on the underside.

title: CLO 2026 Login Error 400 After Successful CLO-SET Login
content:
I am trying to log into CLO 2026 on a new Windows computer, but I consistently receive **Error Code 400** when signing in with CLO-SET.

My account information is correct, and the same account has worked on another computer.

What happens:

  * I select **“Sign in with CLO-SET”** in CLO 2026.

  * Chrome opens normally.

  * I sign into CLO-SET with the correct account.

  * Chrome takes me to the CLO website/homepage.

  * CLO 2026 then displays **Error Code 400** instead of recognizing the login.




I have already tried:

  * Allowing CLO through Windows Defender Firewall.

  * Creating inbound and outbound firewall rules for the CLO Standalone Online Authenticator.

  * Clearing Chrome cache and cookies.

  * Confirming Chrome allows site handlers.

  * Running CLO as administrator.

  * Restarting the computer.

  * Uninstalling and reinstalling the CLO authentication component.




The issue still occurs.

Could you please advise me on how to resolve Error Code 400? I suspect there may be an issue with the **CLO-SET-to-CLO application authentication/handoff**.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi there, I saw that you submitted a ticket and also posted on the Discord. Our team replied to your ticket today, so please check your email and continue the conversation with them there!
content_description: This page seeks troubleshooting advice to resolve Error Code 400 occurring during CLO-SET authentication in CLO 2026 on a new Windows computer.

title: Les Effets et la fonction de Déchirure de marche pas
content:
Ce n'est pas la première fois que j'ai des problèmes avec le logiciel cette fois-ci une nouvelle fonction ne fonctionne pas. Les déchirure ne fonctionnent pas sur mon Mac. J'ai tout essayé tous les paramètres. Justement c'est les paramètre qui manque. Je me suis rendu compte que je n'avais pas la fonction complète. Je peux activer la déchirure mettre la longueur de déchirure mais dans l'éditeur de propriété, j'ai pas les paramètres de l'déchirure, et en plus elle ne se visualise Pas (voir photo) même pas dans la fenêtre 3D.![69c6d654584e4d64b1a2c3d9f68a853b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/69109ac27f2443bbad03a9fa729c0a6f/images/69c6d654584e4d64b1a2c3d9f68a853bCapture%20d%E2%80%99e%CC%81cran%202026-08-19%20a%CC%80%2019.49.25.png)![af1820cdae0e4e67841215883c33b108](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/69109ac27f2443bbad03a9fa729c0a6f/images/af1820cdae0e4e67841215883c33b108Capture%20d%E2%80%99e%CC%81cran%202026-08-20%20a%CC%80%2018.48.58.png) Je me suis dit que si je mettais en vue ma compo de mon ordinateur, Mac clo pourrait peut-être m'expliquer pourquoi ça fonctionne pas. En tout cas si l'un de vous peut m'expliquer ça sera avec énormément de joie que j'accueillerai sa réponse.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Comme répondu précédemment dans l'autre post ainsi que le ticket que vous nous aviez envoyé, cette fonction n'est pour l'instant pas disponible pour les ordinateurs Mac. Nous travaillons pour que l'outil soit accessible dans les prochaines mises à jour.

Comment 2: We also responded to your other comment. This Feature is currently only available on a PC. We hope to expand the feature to Macs in a future update. Thank you for your patience.
content_description: Cette page vise à recueillir de l'aide et des explications concernant un dysfonctionnement de la fonction "déchirure" du logiciel Clo sur Mac, qui n'affiche pas les paramètres ni la visualisation attendue.
